The '''LiteVan IV''' was a model of [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder truck]] built by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This vehicle had no autopilot or cruise control and a very poor maneuverability.
